definitions.gloss: strategy; method; walkthrough; tips for success
definitions.explanation: A method or set of strategies for successfully completing or conquering something, often used for games, tests, or challenges.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{攻略法|こうりゃくほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look up a game walkthrough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{攻略法|こうりゃくほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was taught strategies for passing the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{攻略法|こうりゃくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとめられていて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧、⟦{並|なら}ば→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れる→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: There was a guide online about how to conquer a popular ramen shop, even listing the times you can get in without waiting in line.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}→攻略：12824_kouryaku⟧ (conquest, capture) + ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method). Originally a military term, now widely used in casual and online contexts for tips, tricks, and strategies to succeed at something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{攻略法|こうりゃくほう}: game walkthrough/strategy
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{攻略法|こうりゃくほう}: exam strategies
- {攻略法|こうりゃくほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to compile strategies
- {攻略法|こうりゃくほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: to introduce strategies/tips

USAGE:
Very common in gaming culture and internet usage. Also used more broadly for any kind of challenge—exams, popular restaurants with long lines, job interviews, travel destinations, etc. The nuance is playful and practical rather than military.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{攻略本|こうりゃくぼん}→攻略本：23845_kouryakubon⟧: strategy guidebook (for games)
- ⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}する→攻略する：25273_kouryakusuru⟧: to conquer; to beat (a game, challenge)
